summary: The ProfileIcon component manages the state and appearance of profile and detail icons within a grid view or repeater interface in a web application. It highlights the last clicked icon, clears previous highlights, and relies on ViewState for state management.
purpose: To manage the highlighting of profile and detail icons in a web-based grid or repeater interface, ensuring that user interactions are visually acknowledged and state is properly managed.

workflows.name: Clear Last Profile Highlight
steps: If img has profileopen or profileexistsopen class, reset to default class.

workflows.name: Highlight Profile Icon
steps: Check gridData data keys and ViewState PROFILE_KEY.
Iterate over gridData rows to find matched ID.
Change imgProfile class to profileopen or profileexistsopen.

workflows.name: Clear Last Details Highlight
steps: If img has detailsopen class, reset to default class.

workflows.name: Highlight Details Icon
steps: Check gridData data keys and ViewState DETAILS_KEY.
Iterate over gridData rows to find matched ID.

system_behavior: Uses ViewState to store and retrieve the last-profile state.
Changes CSS class of icons based on interaction state.
exceptions: Ensure the icon control (imgLabel or LinkButton) exists in the UI before attempting to change its class.
